verdict.rationale: Together AI publishes a dedicated Deprecations page describing its model lifecycle policy, covering upgrades, redirects and deprecation schedules, framed so developers "can rely on predictable behavior." It also documents advance notice: an endpoint redirects to its upgraded version only after a 3-day notice. Missing for 10: an explicit notice period specific to full model removal (the cited 3-day notice covers upgrade redirects and is short), detail on how notices are delivered, and independent corroboration that the policy is followed in practice.
